name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires the box in hand there, which is the carry-to-exit pattern and matches the environment's pay condition. Response(box_fell, holding_box) is the stated pick-it-up-again rule. All three clauses are hard and trace to the task.

texts: The agent must reach the exit.
Whenever the agent stands on the exit, it must be carrying the box at that step or later.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again, so it is carrying the box at that step or later.
